negative.description: Scope gating: do not trigger for unrelated geography and weather inquiries

negative.prompt: Book a direct roundtrip flight from New York to London departing next Friday.

negative.description: Scope gating: do not trigger for personal bank account transfers
negative.prompt: Transfer $500 from my checking account to my savings account right now.

positive.description: Freelance consulting invoice with Stripe checkout link and mobile QR code
positive.expected_behavior: A publication-grade vector PDF invoice totaling $3,750.00 with inline high-res PNG preview and embedded vector SVG QR code.
positive.prompt: Generate a freelance consulting invoice from Daniel Hallman at Moosh Works (daniel@mooshworks.com) to Acme Corp (billing@acme.com) for 15 hours of Systems Architecture at $250/hr, due in 14 days, with payment link https://buy.stripe.com/test_inv_123 and a mobile QR code.

positive.expected_behavior: Document re-sequenced to INV-2026-0042, issue date updated to today, due date set to +30 days, status marked pending with payment link.
positive.prompt: Convert my project estimate EST-2026-0042 ($5,000 for Mobile App Design) into an official Tax Invoice due in 30 days with payment link https://buy.stripe.com/test_app_456.

positive.description: Commercial Triple-Net (NNN) lease summary with CAM allocation
positive.expected_behavior: A multi-page commercial lease instrument with itemized monthly base rent ($11,083.33) and CAM ($2,479.17) totaling $13,562.50/mo, operating expense pass-throughs, and mutual signature lines.
positive.prompt: Draft a commercial triple-net (NNN) lease summary for Suite 400 at 100 Innovation Way between Hallman Properties LLC (Landlord) and TechVentures Inc (Tenant), 3,500 sq ft at $38/sqft/yr base rent, plus $8.50/sqft/yr estimated CAM charges, starting November 1, 2026.

positive.description: Invoice payment settlement and official receipt generation
positive.expected_behavior: Official payment receipt document stamped 'PAID IN FULL', balance due updated to $0.00, and transaction audit trail recorded.
positive.prompt: Record full payment of $3,750 for invoice INV-2026-001 received via Stripe Card on October 7, 2026 (transaction ID: ch_3N82jK4v15aw) and generate an official paid receipt.

positive.description: Real-time totals calculation with sales tax and discount inquiry
positive.expected_behavior: Calculates subtotal $3,600.00, tax $333.00, discount $150.00, grand total $3,783.00, and returns the Solo Pro subscription and single-pass pricing.
positive.prompt: Calculate line-item totals with 9.25% sales tax and a $150 early-payment discount for 3 laptops at $1,200 each, and tell me the subscription cost to remove watermarks on future exports.
